tokens.name: tier-steam
tokens.usage: Steam tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GOS's own colour for the Stone and Steam ages; GT has no tier colour here. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-ulv
tokens.usage: ULV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT red. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-lv
tokens.usage: LV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT dark green. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-mv
tokens.usage: MV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT gold. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-hv
tokens.usage: HV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT yellow. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-ev
tokens.usage: EV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT dark grey. Needs the edge token on dark grounds. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-iv
tokens.usage: IV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT blue. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-luv
tokens.usage: LuV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT light purple. Close to "needs you": tier chips only. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-zpm
tokens.usage: ZPM tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT aqua. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-uv
tokens.usage: UV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT dark green, underlined. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-uhv
tokens.usage: UHV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT dark red, underlined. Close to error red: tier chips only. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-uev
tokens.usage: UEV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT dark purple, underlined. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-uiv
tokens.usage: UIV tier chips, ledger bars and flow nodes. GT dark blue, bold underline. Needs the edge token on dark grounds. Always shown with the tier name.

tokens.name: tier-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline edge around dark tier colours (EV, UHV, UEV, UIV) on dark grounds; also the EV core colour.

tokens.name: tier-ink-dark
tokens.usage: Text on light tier chips (Steam, LV, MV, HV, LuV, ZPM, UV).

tokens.name: tier-ink-light
tokens.usage: Text on dark tier chips (EV, IV, UHV, UEV, UIV).

tokens.name: needs-you
tokens.usage: The one "needs you" colour, shared by every dark theme. Field Manual uses its own darker magenta for contrast on paper.
